theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 38 群

items.colloc: delivery van 快遞貨車 | cargo van 載貨廂型車
items.distinct: truck 卡車（較大） | lorry 貨車（英式用法）
ex: The delivery van just arrived at the loading dock.
快遞貨車剛抵達裝卸貨碼頭。
We need a larger van to transport the office equipment.
我們需要更大的貨車來搬運辦公設備。
Please park the company van in the designated area.
請將公司貨車停在指定區域。

items.pos: n. 視野；看法 | v. 觀看；看待
items.colloc: in my view 在我看來 | view from the office 辦公室窗景
items.distinct: opinion 主張；意見 | prospect 前景；期望
ex: This office offers a spectacular view of the harbor.
這間辦公室有絕佳的港口視野。
In my view, we should invest in new technology.
在我看來，我們應該投資新科技。
Management views the current market shift as an opportunity.
管理階層將目前的市場變動視為機會。

items.colloc: sales volume 銷售量 | high volume 大量
items.distinct: amount 總數（不可數） | capacity 容量
ex: The sales volume has increased significantly this quarter.
本季銷售量顯著成長。
Please turn down the volume of the conference call.
請將電話會議的音量調小。
They are managing a high volume of customer inquiries.
他們正在處理大量的客戶詢問。

items.pos: n. 選票；投票 | v. 投票；表決
items.colloc: cast a vote 投下一票 | vote for 支持；投票給
items.distinct: poll 民意調查 | ballot 選票（秘密投票用）
ex: The board will vote on the proposal tomorrow.
董事會明天將針對該提案表決。
Every employee has the right to cast a vote.
每位員工都有權利投下一票。
We need more votes to pass the new policy.
我們需要更多票數來通過這項新政策。

items.colloc: drinking water 飲用水 | water supply 供水
items.distinct: liquid 液體 | fluid 流體
ex: Make sure there is fresh water in the meeting room.
確保會議室裡有新鮮的飲用水。
The plant needs someone to water it every morning.
這盆植物每天早上都需要有人澆水。
We are experiencing a temporary water supply interruption.
我們目前面臨暫時性的供水中斷。

items.pos: adj. 濕的 | v. 弄濕
items.colloc: wet floor 濕滑地板 | soaking wet 濕透的
items.distinct: damp 微濕的 | moist 潮濕的
ex: Please watch out for the wet floor in the lobby.
請小心大廳內濕滑的地板。
The documents got wet during the heavy rainfall.
這些文件在強降雨中被弄濕了。
Keep the sensitive equipment away from wet conditions.
請將精密設備存放在乾燥環境。

items.colloc: hard wood 硬木 | wood furniture 木製家具
items.distinct: timber 木材（建築用） | lumber 木材（美式）
ex: The office desk is made of high-quality wood.
這張辦公桌是用優質木材製成的。
We prefer using wood for the interior renovation.
我們傾向在室內裝修中使用木頭。
The warehouse is filled with crates made of wood.
倉庫裡堆滿了木製板條箱。

items.pos: n. 擔心 | v. 擔心；煩惱
items.colloc: worry about 擔心 | cause for worry 擔心的理由
items.distinct: concern 關切；掛念 | anxiety 焦慮
ex: There is no need to worry about the deadline.
不需要為截止日期感到擔心。
The recent decline in sales is a major worry.
近期銷售額下滑是一個主要的隱憂。
Do not worry about the minor errors in the draft.
不必煩惱草稿中那些微小的錯誤。

items.colloc: in addition 此外 | a new addition 新成員；新添購
items.distinct: extension 擴充 | supplement 補充物
ex: The new software is a valuable addition to our system.
這套新軟體是對我們系統很有價值的補充。
In addition, we need to finalize the contract today.
此外，我們今天需要完成合約定稿。
The addition of new staff will improve our productivity.
增加新員工將提升我們的生產力。

items.pos: n. 代理人；經紀人；代理商
items.colloc: travel agent 旅行社職員 | real estate agent 房地產仲介
items.distinct: representative 代表 | broker 經紀人
ex: Our booking agent confirmed the flight reservation yesterday.
我們的訂位代理人昨天確認了航班預訂。
You should consult a real estate agent for the lease.
你應該諮詢房地產仲介來處理租約。
The insurance agent explained the terms of the policy.
保險代理人說明了保單條款。

items.pos: n. 攻擊 | v. 攻擊；抨擊
items.colloc: cyber attack 網路攻擊 | attack a problem 著手處理問題
items.distinct: assault 突擊 | criticize 批評
ex: The company faced a severe cyber attack last month.
公司上個月遭遇嚴重的網路攻擊。
We need to attack this project with a new strategy.
我們需要用新的策略著手處理這個專案。
The competitor began to attack our pricing model directly.
競爭對手開始直接抨擊我們的定價模式。

items.colloc: right away 立刻 | be away 出差；不在
items.distinct: far 遙遠的 | off 離開；關閉
ex: The manager is away on a business trip this week.
經理這週出差不在辦公室。
Please send the report to the client right away.
請立刻將報告寄給客戶。
Our main office is located away from the city center.
我們的總公司位於遠離市中心的地方。

items.colloc: investment banker 投資銀行家 | senior banker 資深銀行家
items.distinct: clerk 行員 | financier 金融家
ex: The investment banker provided insight on the market trend.
這位投資銀行家提供了市場趨勢的見解。
She has worked as a banker for over ten years.
她擔任銀行從業人員已經超過十年了。
The meeting with the senior banker was very productive.
與資深銀行家的會議非常有成效。

items.colloc: online banking 線上銀行 | banking sector 銀行業
items.distinct: finance 金融 | accounting 會計
ex: The banking sector is experiencing rapid digital transformation.
銀行業正在經歷快速的數位轉型。
Modern banking requires strict security for online transactions.
現代銀行業對線上交易需要嚴格的安全控管。
He decided to pursue a career in corporate banking.
他決定投身於企業金融領域。

items.colloc: sandy beach 沙灘 | beach resort 海濱度假村
items.distinct: coast 海岸 | shore 岸邊
ex: The company retreat will be held at a beach resort.
公司員工旅遊將在海濱度假村舉辦。
They organized a cleanup event at the local beach.
他們在當地的海灘組織了一場淨灘活動。
The hotel offers a private beach for all guests.
這家飯店為所有房客提供私人海灘。

items.colloc: begin with 從...開始 | begin to do 開始做
items.distinct: start 開始 | commence 開始（正式）
ex: The annual meeting will begin at nine o'clock sharp.
年度會議將在九點整準時開始。
We should begin by reviewing the project goals.
我們應該從檢視專案目標開始。
The team will begin to implement the new system soon.
團隊很快就會開始執行新系統。

items.pos: n. 開始 | adj. 初級的
items.colloc: at the beginning 在開始時 | from the beginning 從頭開始
items.distinct: start 起點 | inception 開端
ex: At the beginning of the year, we set new targets.
在年初時，我們設定了新的目標。
The beginning of the presentation was very engaging.
簡報的開場非常引人入勝。
You should read the manual from the beginning.
你應該從頭閱讀這本手冊。

items.colloc: firm belief 堅定的信念 | common belief 一般看法
items.distinct: faith 信心；信仰 | opinion 觀點
ex: Our firm belief is that innovation drives long-term success.
我們堅信創新能推動長期成功。
It is a common belief that hard work leads to rewards.
人們普遍相信努力工作會帶來回報。
His belief in the project motivated the entire team.
他對此專案的信念激勵了整個團隊。

items.pos: n. 品牌 | v. 打上品牌
items.colloc: brand name 品牌名稱 | build a brand 建立品牌
items.distinct: trademark 商標 | label 標籤
ex: This company is famous for its luxury brand image.
這家公司以其奢華的品牌形象聞名。
We are looking for ways to build our brand awareness.
我們正在尋找提升品牌知名度的方法。
Each product should carry the company's official brand.
每項產品都應該標示公司的正式品牌。

items.colloc: bring up 提出；養育 | bring about 導致
items.distinct: take 帶走 | fetch 去拿回來
ex: Please bring your laptop to the team meeting tomorrow.
請明天帶你的筆電來參加團隊會議。
The new marketing strategy will bring in more customers.
新的行銷策略將會帶來更多客戶。
Did you bring the signed contract to the office?
你有把簽好的合約帶到辦公室嗎？
